description_en: Queries the asynchronous execution result of a workflow conversion by submit credential. This is a Skill internal operation
description_zh: Skill 内部接口，按提交凭据查询工作流转换的异步执行结果
name: GetInnerConvertAsyncResult

parameters.help_en: The task ID that uniquely identifies a task
parameters.help_zh: 任务 ID，唯一标识一个任务
parameters.name: task_id

data.description_en: The business data returned by the operation in string format. The specific content varies by operation
data.description_zh: 接口返回的业务数据（字符串形式），具体内容随接口而异

errCode.description_en: The error code. An empty string is returned if the call is successful
errCode.description_zh: 错误码，调用成功时为空字符串

errMessage.description_en: The error message. An empty string is returned if the call is successful
errMessage.description_zh: 错误信息，调用成功时为空字符串

requestId.description_en: The request ID that uniquely identifies the call. Provide this value when troubleshooting issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于唯一标识本次调用；排查问题时请提供该值

success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:
true: The call is successful.
false: The call failed. Troubleshoot the issue based on errCode and errMessage
